description: Defines classes and structures for managing QUIC connection IDs, including peer-issued and self-issued connection ID managers, with related interfaces and data structures.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdData
classes.description: Holds data related to a QUIC connection ID, including the ID itself, sequence number, and reset token.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdManagerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for classes that handle events related to connection ID management, such as retirement and sending new IDs.

classes.name: QuicPeerIssuedConnectionIdManager
classes.description: Manages connection IDs issued by the peer, including tracking active, unused, and retired IDs, and handling related frames.

classes.name: QuicSelfIssuedConnectionIdManager
classes.description: Manages connection IDs issued by the local endpoint, including issuing, retiring, and tracking connection IDs.

methods.name: QuicConnectionIdData
methods.description: Constructor for QuicConnectionIdData.

methods.name: OnPeerIssuedConnectionIdRetired
methods.description: Called when a peer-issued connection ID is retired.

methods.name: SendNewConnectionId
methods.description: Sends a new connection ID frame.

methods.name: MaybeReserveConnectionId
methods.description: Attempts to reserve a connection ID.

methods.name: OnSelfIssuedConnectionIdRetired
methods.description: Called when a self-issued connection ID is retired.

methods.name: QuicPeerIssuedConnectionIdManager
methods.description: Constructor for managing peer-issued connection IDs.

methods.name: OnNewConnectionIdFrame
methods.description: Handles a new connection ID frame received from the peer.

methods.name: ConsumeOneUnusedConnectionId
methods.description: Returns and marks as used one unused connection ID.

methods.name: MaybeRetireUnusedConnectionIds
methods.description: Retires connection IDs no longer on path.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdActive
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is active.

methods.name: ConsumeToBeRetiredConnectionIdSequenceNumbers
methods.description: Returns sequence numbers of IDs pending retirement.

methods.name: ReplaceConnectionId
methods.description: Replaces an old connection ID with a new one.

methods.name: QuicSelfIssuedConnectionIdManager
methods.description: Constructor for managing self-issued connection IDs.

methods.name: MaybeIssueNewConnectionIdForPreferredAddress
methods.description: Possibly issues a new connection ID for preferred address.

methods.name: OnRetireConnectionIdFrame
methods.description: Handles a retire connection ID frame.

methods.name: GetUnretiredConnectionIds
methods.description: Returns all unretired connection IDs.

methods.name: GetOneActiveConnectionId
methods.description: Returns one active connection ID.

methods.name: RetireConnectionId
methods.description: Retires a connection ID when alarm fires.

methods.name: MaybeSendNewConnectionIds
methods.description: Sends new connection IDs if possible.

methods.name: HasConnectionIdToConsume
methods.description: Checks if there is a connection ID to consume.

methods.name: ConsumeOneConnectionId
methods.description: Consumes and returns one connection ID.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdInUse
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is in use.

methods.name: MaybeIssueNewConnectionId
methods.description: Attempts to issue a new connection ID.

methods.name: RetireConnectionId
methods.description: Removes the to-be-retired connection ID.
